title: feat(types,react,sdui-parser)!: retire the node-level visibleOn / hiddenOn / disabledOn spellings
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbASAH4WuLBFpTWVCeQ9PHQu)_

Fixes #25926

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed

## What changed

`@objectstack/spec` declares one conditional-visibility predicate at every layer, `visibleWhen` (ADR-0089). objectui carried three spellings of its own beside the spec's keys: `visibleOn` beside `visibleWhen`, `hiddenOn` beside `hidden`, `disabledOn` beside `disabled`, each pair evaluated by the same code with the same polarity. The three are retired, immediately, with no alias window.

- **`@object-ui/types`** — `BaseSchema.visibleOn` / `hiddenOn` / `disabledOn` are `?: never` tombstones on the TypeScript face and `aliasKeyRefusal` arms on the Zod mirror (the `chartType` → `type` shape). Each refusal names the key, the surviving key, the unchanged polarity, and the remedy ("rename the key; the value is unchanged"). Boolean `visible` stays on `BaseSchema` (see Acceptance note 1).
- **`@object-ui/react`** — `SchemaRenderer`'s visibility chain is `visibleWhen` / `visible` (SHOW legs, negated) and `hidden` (HIDE leg, not negated); the enablement gate is `disabled` alone. A stale retired key that reaches the renderer unvalidated is not consulted and is held out of the component's props (the `body` treatment). The diagnostics' key lists, the props-bag refusal and the fault copy follow.
- **`@object-ui/sdui-parser`** — the three leave `SDUI_BASE_PROPS`; `validateTree` reports each as an `unknown-prop` diagnostic that names the surviving key and says the spelling is retired (`checkRetiredVisibilityDialect`, `RETIRED_VISIBILITY_DIALECTS`, exported).
- **`@object-ui/cli`** — `objectui validate` reads the Zod mirror and prints the tombstone (measured below). `objectui check` keeps the three in `OBJECTUI_STRUCTURAL_KEYS` as identification markers, exactly as it keeps `body` (objectui#6771): a file authored under a retired spelling is still recognised and sent to `validate`; the sweep itself does not parse recognised files (triage ruling objectui#11007).
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`** — the command palette reads a navigation entry's `visible` only; the `?? item.visibleOn` fallback read a key `NavigationItem` never declared.
- **Readers** (components form/action/disclosure renderers, core `declaredPredicate` / `dom-props`, react diagnostics, plugin-chatbot, `complex.ts`): comment-only, the retired spellings dropped from the prose.
- **Tests** — the `hiddenOn` / `disabledOn` / `visibleOn` cases are retired from 13 react/components/sdui-parser pins and the surviving cases re-pointed; two new pins: `node-visibility-dialects-retired.test.ts` (one `invalid_type` issue at the key, message carries `Did you mean X → Y?`, `.describe()` equals the message, `z.input` is `undefined`, both document faces refuse, canonical spellings parse) and `SchemaRenderer.visibilityDialectsRetired.test.tsx` (a stale key is not a leg and does not leak, each with a control on the surviving key).
- **Skill + docs** — `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` and `guides/schema-expressions.md` teach `visibleWhen` / `hidden` / `disabled` (raw expression or `${}` template) and name the retired spellings as refused; `ui/content/docs` `guide/expressions.md`, `api/schema-reference.md`, `guide/schema-playground.md`, plus `guide/schema-rendering.md`, `guide/metadata-diagnostics.md` and `utilities/runner.mdx` (see deviation 1). The form field's view-level `fields[].visibleOn` is a different slot and is left as it was, with a sentence saying so.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/25926-retire-node-visibility-dialects.md` (types / react / sdui-parser minor, app-shell patch; BREAKING; ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` on the objectui-surface precedent of #25831).

## Skills diff readings (lines; tokens = ceil(bytes/4) per `check-skills-token-ratchet`)

| file | lines before → after | tokens before → after |

The guide's net content is paid by deleting one redundant `hidden` template example (the "Data-dependent" pattern duplicated the syntax block above it); the token ratchet is green at the ceiling.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

### 改了什么
objectui 节点上的 `visibleOn` / `hiddenOn` / `disabledOn` 三个拼法退役:类型面变为 `never`,Zod 镜像按名拒绝并指向 `visibleWhen` / `hidden` / `disabled`(同一谓词、同一极性,只改键名,值不变);渲染器只读存活的三个键;SDUI 解析器对 TSX 树同样按名报告;技能包与文档改教存活拼法;`objectui validate` 直接打印拒绝原因。

### 为什么改
规范(ADR-0089)在每一层只声明一个条件可见谓词 `visibleWhen`,从未声明 `*On` 后缀;objectui 自造的三个别名与规范键被同一段代码、同一极性求值,只增加了方言数,没有增加能力。保留别名意味着同一件事有两种写法、两份文档和两组测试要维护。

### 风险与代价(含回滚)
- 风险:任何仍写这三个键的页面/视图/组件文档会在校验时被按名拒绝(有修法提示),渲染时该键被忽略。仓内示例、fixture、技能示例均无命中;文档与技能中的示例已同 PR 改写。
- 代价:四个 `@object-ui/*` 包发版(三个 minor、一个 patch),changeset 已标 BREAKING;无迁移脚本(objectui 面不进 `packages/spec` 的 ADR-0087 账本,沿 #25831 的处置)。
- 回滚:整体 revert 本 PR 即可,无数据迁移、无生成物需要回退(`sdui.manifest.json` 字节不变,仅源码摘要记录重录)。

### 席位意见
(留空)

### 你要做的
1. 确认接受「立即退役、无别名窗口」(派发令如此要求)与 `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` 的判定(认领写的是「按 diff 判定,预期 none」,实测为 narrowed:可写面上的键被 tombstone)。
2. 确认 Acceptance note 1:布尔 `visible` 按规范继续保留在 `BaseSchema` 上(ADR-0089 D4 明确不在范围),派发令中「收敛为 visibleWhen + hidden」的字面读法未照办。
3. 按席位复核后合入;本 PR 为 Tier H,等人批。

## Acceptance notes

1. **`visible` stays.** The order reads "collapse to `visibleWhen` + `hidden`". `visible` is spec-declared on action nodes, app navigation entries, tab rows, `record:alert`, bulk actions, action params and settings, and ADR-0089 D4 keeps boolean `visible` out of scope; the premise comment says "keep boolean `visible` only where the spec declares it". Removing the renderer leg would leave a declared key unevaluated (声明即强制) and would breach the 38-file reader surface. So the chain collapses from five legs to three: `visibleWhen` / `visible` / `hidden`. Flagged for the seat to confirm.
2. **`Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, not `none`.** The claim expected `none` ("ui types only"); the diff tombstones three keys on objectui's authorable node face, which is "a key removed or tombstoned" by ruling A's definition, and the level gate pairs it with the claim's `no (narrowing)` arm. Both lines are on the changeset; the ADR-0087 gate accepts the disposition. The seat may amend the claim.
3. **`objectui check` names nothing by itself.** The order says `validate` / `check` refuse the three by name. `validate` does (measured below). `check` is an advisory sweep that, by the objectui#11007 triage ruling, does not parse a file its structural arm recognised; a stale file is reported "recognised but not validated" and sent to `validate`. Dropping the three markers instead would let a leaf file carrying only a retired key and an unregistered `type` fall out of the sweep unmentioned, which is the silence the `body` precedent refused. Left as the ruling has it; the seat may rule otherwise.
4. **Out of scope, found while reading:** the table-slot refusals in `zod/objectql.zod.ts` (`tableKeyRefusal('hiddenOn')` and siblings at lines 1171–1199) still prescribe "belongs on the object-view node itself", which now points at a tombstoned spelling. Not this card's keys; for the seat to file. `responsive.hiddenOn`, `FormField.visibleOn` (view-level) and the `suggestions.zod.ts` examples are untouched as the order states.

## Deviations

1. **File surface, docs:** the claim lists `guide/expressions.md`, `api/schema-reference.md`, `guide/schema-playground.md`. Three more files under `ui/content/docs` taught the retired spellings as live node keys (`guide/schema-rendering.md` ×11, `guide/metadata-diagnostics.md` ×3 node-level mentions, `utilities/runner.mdx` ×1) and are fixed in place under the bounded in-place-fix exemption (same defect class, mechanical rename, same gate family, no new verification surface). The seat is asked to amend the claim's file surface.
2. **Ablation docblock corrected once:** the new react pin's reverse-verification paragraph first named the `VISIBILITY_*_KEYS` lists as the ablation site; the first ablation stayed green because the legs are hand-written `if` blocks and the lists only drive diagnostics. The paragraph now names the leg; the second ablation (one restored leg) went red on exactly the predicted case. Both runs are in the report.

## Verification

- `objectui validate` on `{ "type": "text", "content": "Open", "visibleOn": "data.ok" }` → exit 1, one error at `visibleOn`, code `invalid_type`, message "Unrecognized key(s) on this node: `visibleOn`. Did you mean `visibleOn` → `visibleWhen`? …Rename the key; the value is unchanged."; the same node spelled `visibleWhen` → exit 0.
- Reverse verification (TypeScript face): `visibleOn: 'data.ok'` pasted into the typed node literal of the new types test → `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` red, TS2322 "Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'undefined'" at line 78; restored via `git checkout HEAD -- FILE` → green.
- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation landed and restored, blob == HEAD): restoring a `visibleOn` leg after the `visible` leg in `SchemaRenderer.tsx` → `SchemaRenderer.visibilityDialectsRetired.test.tsx` 1 failed | 6 passed, the failing case being "`visibleOn: "false"` is not a SHOW leg"; the earlier list-only mutation stayed 7 passed (recorded, see deviation 2).
- Type-check: `@object-ui/types`, `core`, `sdui-parser`, `components`, `react`, `app-shell`, `cli`, `plugin-chatbot` — all exit 0 after `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/cli...' --filter '@object-ui/app-shell...' build`.
- Tests: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/ packages/sdui-parser/ packages/react/ packages/components/ packages/plugin-chatbot/ --maxWorkers=2` (under the verify lock, 19m58s) → first run 1 failed | 1050 passed (`static-table-narrow-surface.test.ts` pinned the table mirror's exact tombstone set, which now inherits the three node-face tombstones; re-pointed in 6f044d46, that file alone re-run: 39 passed); `… packages/app-shell/ --maxWorkers=2` → Test Files 1735 passed | 1 skipped (1736), Tests 15960 passed | 9 skipped; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/core test` → 211 files passed; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/cli test` → 30 files passed; the 13 directly touched/new pins run alone → 13 files, 267 tests passed. (Per-package `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types test` fails with `spawn ENOENT` from the repo root: vitest lives in `ui/node_modules/.bin`, so the ui suites are run from `ui/`.)
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 68 families at the final head; every command run from the worktree with its exit captured before any pipe; `--ran` reconciliation: 68 derived, 68 run, 0 UNRUN. 66 exit 0. `pnpm check:type-check-debt` → re-run under the lock after the suites (exit 0, held the lock 131s). `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` → exit 99 (never acquired the lock behind the 74-minute app-shell run; a full-build gate CI runs on the PR, not re-run here).
- Dogfood battery (final head, `(narrowing)` arm): head 6f044d46, after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build` (exit 0); `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock → VERDICT command-exit 0 · held the lock 973s (16m13s) · Test Files 297 passed | 3 skipped (300) · Tests 2527 passed | 18 skipped (2545); no failure.
- `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main`: 0 anchored files, nothing judged. `check-skills-token-ratchet`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check-sdui-manifest` all green on the committed tree.
